plain: Quit wasting money on fees for spending more than you have. With our account, you'll never pay $35 just because you went $5 below zero.
alt: Say goodbye to costly overdraft fees. Go $5 over with our account and you'll never get hit with a $35 charge.
frame_flip: Keep more of your money every month. With our account, going $5 over means you hold on to the $35 other banks would charge you.
reordered: Our account never charges you $35 for going $5 over. So you can stop losing money to overdraft fees.
